subject: STABLE lowering-opus for C6o (11:30): handle reclaim + MAX_BO 1024 with P8 fallback, mip-level attachments, memoryless 4x backing, MRT FAU blend-word fix, batch cap 128 default; compiler MRT tile fetch (inert until used)
body:
Hashes: nord2_metal_bridge.c a00fd9cc; nord2_metal_render.c 9f10ce79; nord2_render_pass.inc c198137e; render_encoder.inc b984f746 (holds others' hunks); nord2_transport.inc fa7ce90d; ab_schedule.inc ec0d6a3c; mali_graphics_compiler.c 99d566b5 (holds others' hunks; mine = MULTI_TARGET+TILE_FETCH region); tests bridge 2cc885db render 94d9f0e8; build/encode-cpu-20261026 ab_schedule_main.m bcb4f4ca ab_schedule_test.py ca68be4f.
(1) Bridge handle table: MAX_BO 1024 (56 B/entry = 56 KiB per bridge, was 14 KiB); scans bounded by a high-water mark; usable cap starts at 1024 and drops to 256 on the first kernel ALLOC refusal at exactly 256 live handles (P8 N2C_MAX_BOS), so P8 and P9 (0105) both work; table-full first reaps, frees idle pooled command blocks, then cached code (c6n: 21x NOTREADY site 1490 at bos=256). Test: fake kernel with a 256 cap -> 256 allocations then refusal, slot reuse; unlimited -> 300. (2) Pass attachments at mip level>0 render into an owned single-level view (c6n render_pass:92, 20 commands); a memoryless 4x target without backing gets scratch storage at its first pass (render_pass:129). (3) True-MRT FS blend words: FAU 48+8*rt now written per target with fixed_function.rt=rt (before: rt1..3 outputs of every true-MRT draw used a zero conversion word on device). (4) JM batch cap 128 default (NORD2_METAL_BATCH_MAX=32 / BM0 phase restores 32; c6n per-draw -13%, 0 failures in 871 cmds). (5) Compiler (inert until a caller uses it): MULTI_TARGET may now combine with TILE_FETCH; a fetch of attachment j = LD_TILE rt=j with conversion FAU 48+8j (not counted as written). Private host .so check: 2 subpass inputs -> 2 LD_TILE (u6/u7), written mask 1, fetch=TILE; unbound attachment refused.
